description: AAA says the national average for a gallon of gas is more than $4.39 per gallon, which is up nine cents since Thursday. President Trump claims the pain at the pump will end when the Iran war does. Nancy Cordes reports.
title: Trump says gas prices "will go down rapidly" when Iran war ends as Americans face rising costs

description: Police arrested a man for allegedly incinerating his dead wife at the zoo where he worked, officials said, following the discovery of human remains.
title: Man arrested for allegedly dumping wife's body in zoo incinerator

description: Federal telecom regulators can revoke broadcast licenses, but legal experts say the FCC would face a tough road in forcing ABC to go dark.
title: Could the FCC really yank ABC's TV licenses amid Trump spat with Kimmel?

description: Hundreds of foreign doctors about to complete training in the U.S. will have to leave the country if the federal government doesn't rapidly process their visa waiver applications, immigration attorneys say.
title: Delays in visa program threaten placement of hundreds of doctors in underserved areas

description: The Kentucky Derby will see a full field of 20 horses in the first leg of the 2026 competition for horse racing's Triple Crown.
title: Meet the horses running in the Kentucky Derby
